programme.title: In 3 days you will be dead / In 3 Tagen bist du tot
programme.desc: "In 3 days you are dead", an anonymous SMS of the 18-year-old Nina. And not just you, but all friends of your clique. Obviously a bad joke to the Matura just passed. During the wet party, Nina's friend Martin disappears without a trace. The next day he is found dead, tied up and cruelly drowned. Little later the next murder happens. There is no motif and no traces. / "In 3 Tagen bist du tot" verkundet eine anonyme SMS der 18-jahrigen Nina. Und nicht nur ihr, sondern allen Freunden ihrer Clique. Offensichtlich ein schlechter Scherz zur soeben bestandenen Matura. Wahrend der feuchtfrohlichen Party verschwindet Ninas Freund Martin spurlos. Am nachsten Tag wird er tot gefunden, gefesselt und grausam ertrankt. Wenig spater geschieht der nachste Mord. Es gibt kein Motiv und keine Spuren.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk plays along / Mr. Monk spielt mit
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to drive a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police service. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.desc: Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 A note is wrong / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First the topic of the term searched is announced. programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but at all it cannot make friends with the Caribbean mentality. This always ensures entertaining situations. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: World without meat? - The food of the future / Welt ohne Fleisch? - Die Ernahrung der Zukunft
programme.desc: There will be nine billion people in 2050. If the eating habits are not different, at least twice as much meat had to be produced to cover the global need. After she wakes up again, she has the memories of another red -haired woman. Her behavior also differentiates: she flows Italian, eats meat as a vegetarian and makes her own radio show. Auch ihr Verhalten andert sich: Sie spricht flieSSend Italienisch, isst als Vegetarierin Fleisch und macht eine eigene Radiosendung. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Motorsport: Le Mans Cup
programme.desc: The Frenchman David and Kolner Hugo Schwarze secured the victory this year. It was the second triumph in a row for the duo from the team R-Ace GP. After the race in Silverstone, both drivers had 90 points in the overall ranking. In the LMP3 Pro-AM category, the British Terrence Woodward and James Winslow won in front of their home audience. 5. Station: Silverstone / Den Sieg sicherten sich in diesem Jahr der Franzose Hadrien David und der Kolner Hugo Schwarze. Es war der zweite Triumph in Folge fur das Duo aus dem Team R-ace GP. Nach dem Rennen in Silverstone hatten beide Fahrer 90 Punkte in der Gesamtwertung. In der LMP3-Pro-Am-Kategorie siegten die Briten Terrence Woodward und James Winslow vor ihrem Heimpublikum. 5. Station: Silverstone

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: FudBal - Copa Libertadores / Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: The "Copa Libertadores" is the annual competition founded in 1960. year and the 38 best teams of South America occur. Throughout history, the format of the competition changed, of which only the champions in their leagions have the right to perform until today when each state gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's giant independence. Argentina also gave the most wins of Kope. The competition has iconic status and is considered one of the suburbs of soccer events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Poland League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league of Poland. The first league of Poland in football was founded in 1927. years, and the League organizes the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of the Polish Champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.desc: The entertaining teenage quiz has the ambitious goal of providing viewers with a new view of the possibility of the learning material being presented in the public space through modern and interactive television games. Arktik
programme.desc: The man who stuck in the Arctic finally arrives with a long -awaited salvation. But after a tragic accident, he loses his opportunity. He has to decide whether to remain in the relative security of his camp or print on the deadly path. / Čovjeku koji je zaglavio na Arktiku napokon stiže dugo očekivan spas. No nakon tragične nesreće, on gubi svoju priliku. Mora odlučiti hoće li ostati u relativnoj sigurnosti svoga kampa ili se otisnuti na smrtonosni put.

programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Jill (Amanda Seyfried) returns home after a night shift and reveals that her sister Molly has been abducted. A year ago, Jill managed to escape the kidnapper and is convinced that the same serial killer returned to Molly. Since the killer has left no trace, the police have no evidence and cannot help her. Fearing that Molly would be dead before the morning, Jill goes on a standalone chase to face the killer. Will she have enough time to outsmart him, discover his secrets and save his sister? / Jill (Amanda Seyfried) se vraća kući nakon noćne smjene i otkriva da je njena sestra Molly oteta. Prije godinu dana Jill je uspjela pobjeći otmičaru i uvjerena je da se isti serijski ubojica vratio po Molly. Pošto ubojica nije ostavio nikakav trag, policija nema dokaza i ne može joj pomoći. Strahujući da će Molly biti mrtva prije jutra, Jill kreće u samostalnu potjeru kako bi se suočila s ubojicom.Da li će imati dovoljno vremena da ga nadmudri, otkrije njegove tajne i spasi sestru?

programme.title: Dijete Ozirisa
programme.desc: The film is located at the time of the interplanetary colonization, where we meet Sya Lombroka, a former paramedic of a dark past running out of prison. He will make an unusual alliance with Kane Sommerville, a sergeant who works for the exor military company. In the race over time, the two of them will try to save Kane's daughter of Indi, and prevent a global crisis that could cause exor. / Film je smješten u vrijeme međuplanetarne kolonizacije, gdje upoznajemo Sya Lombroka, bivšeg bolničara mračne prošlosti koji bježi iz zatvora. On će sklopiti neobično savezništvo s Kaneom Sommervilleom, narednikom koji radi za vojnu kompaniju Exor. U trci s vremenom, njih dvojica će pokušati spasiti Kaneovu kći Indi, i spriječiti globalnu krizu koju bi mogao izazvati Exor.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: NBA Classic Games - (Sport. Program, USA) sixth day of June, back in 1946, will forever change the basketball game. Timovi su podijeljeni na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju i kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Prvaci konferencije ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje odlučuju o novom prvaku u seriji od najviše sedam utakmica. NBA finale jedan je od najgledanijih sportskih događaja godine koji oduševljava sve ljubitelje košarke...

programme.title: Koprivnica - Hajduk, SuperSport Hrvatski nogometni kup
programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025/2026) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025/2026) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.desc: Basketball: Eurocup - (Sport. Placement in the Euro Cup is provided through national championships and buys, and through the so -called invitations. "Wildcards". The second in the strength competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Cup of Radivoj Korac and the Cup Saport. The importance of this competition is that the winner ensures the right to compete the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague ... / Basketball: EuroCup - (sport. program) Eurokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo natjecanje Euroleague Basketball, U ovom natjecanju se natječu najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Euroligu, te u njemu sudjeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih europskih liga. Plasman u Eurokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "wildcards". Drugo po jačini natjecanje u europskoj košarci nastalo je spajanjem FIba Kupa Radivoja Koraća i Saporta Kupa. programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025/2026) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025/2026) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. programme.title: Cibona - Prievidza, qualifications for FIBA ​​Europe Cup 2025/2026. / Cibona - Prievidza, Kvalifikacije za FIBA Europe Cup 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Basketball: Eurocup - (Sport. Program) Euro Cup was created in 2002 as a second Euroleague Basketball competition, the strongest basketball clubs compete in this competition, which fails to win the Euroleague, and mostly clubs from the top 15 European League participate in it. Placement in the Euro Cup is provided through national championships and buys, and through the so -called invitations. "Wildcards". The second in the strength competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Cup of Radivoj Korac and the Cup Saport. The importance of this competition is that the winner ensures the right to compete the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague ... / Basketball: EuroCup - (sport. program) Eurokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo natjecanje Euroleague Basketball, U ovom natjecanju se natječu najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Euroligu, te u njemu sudjeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih europskih liga. Plasman u Eurokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "wildcards". Drugo po jačini natjecanje u europskoj košarci nastalo je spajanjem FIba Kupa Radivoja Koraća i Saporta Kupa. Značaj za ovo natjecanje je da pobjednik osigurava pravo natjecati se naredne sezone u najjačem klupskom košarkaškom natjecanju u Europi, Euroligi...

programme.title: Uljanik - Osijek, SuperSport Croatian Football Cup / Uljanik - Osijek, SuperSport Hrvatski nogometni kup
programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025/2026) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025/2026) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.title: Cibona - Prievidza, qualifications for FIBA ​​Europe Cup 2025/2026. / Cibona - Prievidza, Kvalifikacije za FIBA Europe Cup 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Basketball: Eurocup - (Sport. Program) Euro Cup was created in 2002 as a second Euroleague Basketball competition, the strongest basketball clubs compete in this competition, which fails to win the Euroleague, and mostly clubs from the top 15 European League participate in it. Placement in the Euro Cup is provided through national championships and buys, and through the so -called invitations. "Wildcards". The second in the strength competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Cup of Radivoj Korac and the Cup Saport. The importance of this competition is that the winner ensures the right to compete the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague ... / Basketball: EuroCup - (sport. program) Eurokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo natjecanje Euroleague Basketball, U ovom natjecanju se natječu najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Euroligu, te u njemu sudjeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih europskih liga. Plasman u Eurokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "wildcards". Drugo po jačini natjecanje u europskoj košarci nastalo je spajanjem FIba Kupa Radivoja Koraća i Saporta Kupa. Značaj za ovo natjecanje je da pobjednik osigurava pravo natjecati se naredne sezone u najjačem klupskom košarkaškom natjecanju u Europi, Euroligi...

programme.desc: Basketball: Eurocup - (Sport. Program) Euro Cup was created in 2002 as a second Euroleague Basketball competition, the strongest basketball clubs compete in this competition, which fails to win the Euroleague, and mostly clubs from the top 15 European League participate in it. Placement in the Euro Cup is provided through national championships and buys, and through the so -called invitations. "Wildcards". The second in the strength competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Cup of Radivoj Korac and the Cup Saport. The importance of this competition is that the winner ensures the right to compete the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague ... / Basketball: EuroCup - (sport. program) Eurokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo natjecanje Euroleague Basketball, U ovom natjecanju se natječu najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Euroligu, te u njemu sudjeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih europskih liga. Plasman u Eurokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "wildcards". Drugo po jačini natjecanje u europskoj košarci nastalo je spajanjem FIba Kupa Radivoja Koraća i Saporta Kupa. Značaj za ovo natjecanje je da pobjednik osigurava pravo natjecati se naredne sezone u najjačem klupskom košarkaškom natjecanju u Europi, Euroligi...

programme.title: David und Goliath
programme.desc: Dina Schwarz, a new psychotherapist at the Essen Clinic, is about to take over the mammoth task of relieving the psychosocial care of around 4,000 employees. This attendance discussion takes a dramatic turn when she stops the intensive care nurse Nathan Freye at the last second, but breaks his arm. The clinic chief, Ms. Jelinek, makes Dina an offer: to hide the incident and to accept the job for it. But Dina provides a condition: an assistant. This is how her balancing act begins between the challenges of the clinic, the needs of her sister Kiki, who has Down syndrome and expected from Dina to clear the internal family problems. Dina also pursues her past and does not seem to let her go. When her assistant Anton Zinser runs her through the clinic, Dina notes how far the fuking level seems to be from the actual challenges of everyday clinical practice. It recognizes the need to be close to people to help them effectively. Schultholz, the senior physician of the intensive care unit, who is skeptical of their methods. Both Dr. Schultholz as well as Nathan, who recovered from his attempted suicide, are not ready to speak to Dina. Dina understands that many employees suffer from overload and stress, but do not want to speak about it for fear. Especially Dr. Schultholz is critical of Dina's approach. Throughout that, Muhsam fights through the everyday clinical practice and finds support from nursing officer Adem. However, access to the nursing staff is a challenge with progress and jerking, so that Dina has to use her very own methods in order to obtain Ms. Jelinek from creating two vacancies for the intensive care unit to reduce the pressure. At the same time, she starts a podcast on mental health and burnout with Nathan. Your goal is to establish a culture of the supply and support, even if she knows that the path is stony. The message is clear: everyone needs support, even those who save others. Dina has come to stay and it will not let up until the Essen clinic is a place where the employees get understood and supports. / Dina Schwarz, eine neue Psychotherapeutin an der Essener Klinik, steht vor der Mammutaufgabe, die psychosoziale Betreuung von rund 4.000 Mitarbeitenden zu ubernehmen.Dinas Einstellungsgesprach nimmt eine dramatische Wendung, als sie in letzter Sekunde den Intensivpfleger Nathan Freye davon abhalt, sich das Leben zu nehmen, dabei jedoch seinen Arm bricht. Die Klinikchefin, Frau Jelinek, macht Dina ein Angebot: den Vorfall zu verschweigen und dafur den Job anzunehmen. Doch Dina stellt eine Bedingung: einen Assistenten. So beginnt ihr Balanceakt zwischen den Herausforderungen der Klinik, den Bedurfnissen ihrer Schwester Kiki, die das Down-Syndrom hat und von Dina erwartet, die innerfamiliaren Probleme zu klaren. Auch verfolgt Dina ihre Vergangenheit und scheint sie nicht loslassen zu wollen.Als ihr Assistent Anton Zinser sie durch die Klinik fuhrt, bemerkt Dina, wie weit entfernt die Fuhrungsebene von den eigentlichen Herausforderungen des Klinikalltags scheint. Sie erkennt die Notwendigkeit, naher an den Menschen zu sein, um ihnen effektiv helfen zu konnen.Beim Kennenlernen der Mitarbeitenden stoSSt Dina auf Widerstand, insbesondere von Dr. Schultholz, dem Oberarzt der Intensivstation, der ihre Methoden skeptisch betrachtet. Sowohl Dr. Schultholz als auch Nathan, der sich von seinem Suizidversuch erholt, sind nicht bereit, mit Dina zu sprechen. Dina begreift, dass viele Mitarbeitende unter Überlastung und Stress leiden, aber aus Angst nicht daruber sprechen wollen. Besonders Dr. Schultholz steht Dinas Ansatz kritisch gegenuber.Dina kampft sich muhsam durch den Klinikalltag und findet Unterstutzung bei Pfleger Adem. Doch der Zugang zum Pflegepersonal gestaltet sich als Herausforderung mit Fortschritten und Ruckschlagen.So muss Dina ihre ganz eigenen Methoden anwenden, um Frau Jelinek davon zu uberzeugen, zwei offene Stellen fur die Intensivstation zu schaffen, um den Druck zu mindern. Gleichzeitig startet sie mit Nathan einen Podcast uber psychische Gesundheit und Burnout. Ihr Ziel ist es, eine Kultur des Zuhorens und der Unterstutzung zu etablieren, auch wenn sie weiSS, dass der Weg steinig ist.Die Botschaft ist klar: Jeder braucht Unterstutzung, selbst diejenigen, die andere retten. Dina ist gekommen, um zu bleiben, und sie wird nicht nachlassen, bis die Essener Klinik ein Ort ist, an dem sich die Mitarbeitenden verstanden und unterstutzt fuhlen.

But the closer he gets to the whole truth, the more dangerous it becomes for him and his family - because the Drakic siblings are not only targeting the hated commissario. You want to meet him by attacking his children Livia (Sophia Thomalla) and Marco (Sergej Moya). When Livia becomes the victim of a brutal robbery, Laurenti goes all over. With all hard he puts the hits under pressure. But then he himself becomes the victim of a murder attack. Happed by a ball, Laurenti uses the assassination attempt to exchange his death. programme.desc: A huge storm is familiar with. Hurricane about the airport. Fracht and mull containers have to be tied, airplanes are safely parked. Follow-me driver Mario Hahn. With the two experienced commissioners Finn Kiesewetter (Sven Martinek) and Lars Englen (Ingo Najouks), she fought for justice. On the open lake, two fishermen make a disturbing find. In an abandoned boat you discover the body of the 21-year Sofie Albers and her crying, ten-month-old son Leon. Together with his colleague Lars Englen, Finn Kiesewetter takes the investigation. A first suspect is quickly found: Sofie-looking ex-boyfriend Peter Jansen was the last to see the young mother alive. But then Sofie's diary betrayed that she had a secret relationship with the doctor Knut Lorens. / Das Verbrechen schlaft nie in Lubeck. Das bekommt auch Staatsanwaltin Hilke Zobel (Proschat Madani) zu spuren, als sie die Nachfolge von Elke Rasmussen antritt. Mit den beiden erfahrenen Kommissaren Finn Kiesewetter (Sven Martinek) und Lars Englen (Ingo Najouks) kampft sie fur Gerechtigkeit.Auf offener See machen zwei Fischer einen verstorenden Fund. In einem verlassenen Boot entdecken sie die Leiche der 21-jahrigen Sofie Albers und ihren weinenden, zehn Monate alten Sohn Leon. Gemeinsam mit seinem Kollegen Lars Englen nimmt Finn Kiesewetter die Ermittlungen auf. Ein erster Verdachtiger ist schnell gefunden: Sofies drogensuchtiger Ex-Freund Peter Jansen war der letzte, der die junge Mutter lebend gesehen hat. Doch dann verrat Sofies Tagebuch, dass sie ein heimliches Verhaltnis mit dem Arzt Knut Lorens hatte.

programme.title: Death in Paradise

programme.title: Kabarettgipfel
programme.desc: You are less common. And a round of fun is guaranteed at funft on the gray! On today's topic "similarities" Gernot Kulis immediately thinks of relationships, specifically to couples: "These are simply people who have failed as singles." Although relationships can also make fun if you take it with humor. Not always easy in the Kulis household, because the children want to save the world and stick to it on the ground. Stumbling blocks guaranteed! Lydia Prenner-Kasper first thinks of sleep deprivation when it comes to children. No wonder she has three of them. So children, not sleep deprivation. Chronic mude searches for remedies in the cosmetics industry and fantasizes whether smooth skin guarantees a happily pension. Martin Frank also struggles with aging, he is noticing in everyday life because he already talks like his grandma. Perhaps it comes to the fact that he is in the company in the company of old women, in the electricity channel of an indoor pool to be precise. And the wild life is also raging with him at the cemetery. Less rages in the life of Andreas Vitásek, his dog is dead. So more precisely, his pug has died. That let him think about the finiteness and the hereafter and about God. There is only one god for him, Bob Dylan. Hopefully he will let him enter him at Himmelstor. Sonja Pikart also has to cope with a loss. It goes through a separation and might keep the pasta test. Sounds funny, it is too. With the sieve in the pack, she moves into a new apartment and might get to know the house community. A very bad idea, however, for us a very entertaining, the cabaret artists are accompanied musically by the all-female formation "KGB-the cabaret summit". / GemeinsamkeitenZusammen ist man weniger allein. Und zu funft auf der Buhne ist ein Reigen an SpaSS garantiert! Beim heutigen Thema "Gemeinsamkeiten" denkt Gernot Kulis sofort an Beziehungen, konkret an Paare: "Das sind einfach Menschen, die als Singles gescheitert sind." Wobei Beziehungen auch Freude machen konnen, wenn man es mit Humor nimmt. Nicht immer leicht im Haushalt Kulis, denn die Kinder wollen die Welt retten und kleben sich dafur am Boden fest. Stolperfallen garantiert! Lydia Prenner-Kasper denkt beim Thema Kinder zuerst an Schlafentzug. Kein Wunder, sie hat ja drei davon. Also Kinder, nicht Schlafentzug. Chronisch mude sucht sie nach Abhilfe in der Kosmetikindustrie und fantasiert, ob glatte Haut eine gluckliche Pension garantiert. Martin Frank hadert auch mit dem Altern, ihm fallt das im Alltag auf, weil er schon redet wie seine Oma. Vielleicht kommts daher, dass er sich ofter in Gesellschaft alterer Damen befindet, im Stromungskanal eines Hallenbades um genau zu sein. Und auch am Friedhof tobt bei ihm das wilde Leben. Weniger tobt es im Leben von Andreas Vitásek, sein Hund ist tot. Also genauer, sein Mops ist gestorben. Das lasst ihn uber die Endlichkeit und das Jenseits nachdenken und uber Gott. Fur ihn gibt es nur einen Gott, Bob Dylan. Na hoffentlich lasst der ihn mal beim Himmelstor eintreten. Sonja Pikart muss auch einen Verlust verkraften. Sie geht durch eine Trennung und mochte das Nudelsieb behalten. Klingt lustig, ist es auch. Mit dem Sieb im Gepack zieht sie in eine neue Wohnung und mochte die Hausgemeinschaft kennenlernen. Eine ganz schlechte Idee, fur uns allerdings eine sehr unterhaltsame.Musikalisch begleitet werden die Kabarettistinnen und Kabarettisten wieder von der All-Female-Formation "KGB - Die Kabarettgipfelband".

programme.title: Do you want to go with me? / Willst Du mit mir gehen?
programme.desc: In the middle of the picturesque vineyards on the Anninger near Gumpoldskirchen, Single Marlies is looking for the man of her dreams. Romantic walks, intensive conversation and varied relationship tests show who really suits her: whether mucking out an alpaca stall together, when overcoming the Hohenangstam climbing rock or with a shaky round of pair acrobatics. This shows whether the chemistry is right. Who conquers Marlies heart? The Kartner Auto-Tuner Omar, who tries to convince with a confident appearance and clear announcements? The Tyrolean Andreas, who fully advertises the single lady and even took his guitar with it? A special surprise is a candidate Roman: the two have already met. Will the supposed friendship become more of this time? Moderator Michelle accompanies Marlies on her adventure. / Inmitten der malerischen Weinberge am Anninger bei Gumpoldskirchen ist Single Marlies auf der Suche nach dem Mann ihrer Traume. Romantische Spaziergange,intensive Gesprache und abwechslungsreiche Beziehungstests zeigen, wer wirklich zu ihr passt: ob beim gemeinsamen Ausmisten eines Alpakastalls, beim Überwinden der Hohenangstam Kletterfels oder bei einer wackeligen Runde Paarakrobatik. Hier zeigt sich, ob die Chemie stimmt. Wer erobert Marlies Herz? Der Kartner Auto-Tuner Omar, der mit selbstbewusstem Auftreten und klaren Ansagen von sich zu uberzeugen versucht? Der Tiroler Andreas, der mit vollem Einsatz um die Single-Dame wirbt und sogar seine Gitarre mitgenommen hat? Eine besondere Überraschung ist Kandidat Roman: Die beiden sind sich schon einmal begegnet. Wird aus der vermeintlichen Freundschaft diesmal mehr? Moderatorin Michelle begleitet Marlies auf ihrem Abenteuer.

programme.title: Der Leuchtturm
programme.desc: Gripping drama by Robert Eggers (The Northman, Nosferatu). Willem Dafoe and Robert Pattinson embark on an impressive Tour de Force in the seclusion of a lighthouse. A violent storm escalates the tense situation at the end of the 19th century, at the rough Atlantic custody of New England. Ephraim Winslow wants to start a fresh start and for four weeks overturns the open position on a lighthouse. There he is subordinate to the old, experienced waiting for Thomas Wake as a young assistant. During this at night around the light, Ephraim has to do the difficult work during the day. Tensions are inevitable. When a violent storm appears, the situation is out of control. / Packendes Drama von Robert Eggers (The Northman, Nosferatu). Willem Dafoe und Robert Pattinson begeben sich in der Abgeschiedenheit eines Leuchtturms auf eine eindrucksvolle Tour de force. Ein heftiger Sturm lasst die gespannte Situation eskalieren.Gegen Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts, an der rauen Atlantikkuste Neuenglands. Ephraim Winslow will einen Neuanfang starten und ubernimmt fur vier Wochen den offenen Posten auf einem Leuchtturm. Dort ist er als junger Gehilfe dem alten, erfahrenen Warter Thomas Wake unterstellt. Wahrend dieser sich nachts um das Licht kummert, muss Ephraim tagsuber die schwere Arbeit erledigen. Spannungen sind unvermeidlich. Als ein heftiger Sturm aufzieht, gerat die Situation auSSer Kontrolle.

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Awarded, gripping social satire with thrill. 2020 awarded four Oscars: as the best film, as an international film, for the direction and the original script. A young person from precarious relationships dizzy into the world of the upper class as a tutor and scares nothing back to accommodate his members as staff in the new -rich family. Oder clouds move up because the luxury villa hides a dark secret. Excitement up to the last minute! The four -headed family Kim is struggling through life in their musty basement with casual work. The young son Ki-Woo can take over the English lessons of a tutoring school. In the luxury villa of the wealthy Park family, a new world grows. In tricky, he uses every chance to put his sister, father and mother into the staff of the parks. Nobody suspects that there is an ominous secret in the house. / Preisgekronte, packende Gesellschaftssatire mit Thrill. 2020 mit vier Oscars ausgezeichnet: als bester Film, als internationaler Film, fur die Regie und das Originaldrehbuch. Ein Jugendlicher aus prekaren Verhaltnissen schwindelt sich als Nachhilfelehrer in die Welt der Upper Class und schreckt vor nichts zuruck, um seine Angehorigen als Personal bei der neureichen Familie unterzubringen. Unheilvolle Wolken ziehen auf, denn die Luxus-Villa verbirgt ein dunkles Geheimnis. Spannung bis zur letzten Minute!Die vierkopfige Familie Kim schlagt sich in ihrer muffigen Kellerwohnung mit Gelegenheitsarbeiten durchs Leben. Da kann der junge Sohn Ki-woo den Englisch-Unterricht einer Nachhilfeschulerin seines Freundes ubernehmen. In der Luxus-Villa der wohlhabenden Familie Park eroffnet sich ihm eine neue Welt. Trickreich nutzt er jede Chance, seine Schwester, seinen Vater und seine Mutter ins Personal der Parks einzuschleusen. Keiner ahnt, dass sich im Haus ein unheilvolles Geheimnis verbirgt.

programme.desc: Der Nationalrat beginnt mit einer Plenarsitzung sein Arbeitsjahr mit sechs Gesetzesbeschlussen. Unter anderem wird uber das Waffengesetz und eine Novelle zum ORF-Gesetz beraten. Beginnen wird die Sitzung mit einer Gedenkminute fur den verstorbenen ehemaligen Zweiten Nationalratsprasidenten Heinrich Neisser (ÖVP). Ebenfalls beraten werden einige Volksbegehren, unter anderem zur Abschaffung der ORF-Haushaltsabgabe und einem NATO-Beitrittsverbot. Zur Beschlussfassung liegt die Verscharfung des Waffengesetzes in Folge des Amoklaufs an einer Grazer Schule vor. Bei den ORF-Materien geht es unter anderem um die Abschaffung des Anhorungsrechts der Lander bei der Bestellung von ORF-Landesdirektoren sowie um die Entlastung von Unternehmen mit mehreren Standorten bei der ORF-Gebuhr. Neben Rechnungshofberichten steht noch ein EntschlieSSungsantrag fur ein MaSSnahmenpaket zur Forderung der Geschlechtergerechtigkeit in der KI auf der Tagesordnung. Einer Ersten Lesung unterzogen wird schlieSSlich ein von der FPÖ vorgelegtes "Feuerwehr-Entburokratisierungsgesetz", mit dem sie eine NoVA-Befreiung bei Einsatzfahrzeugen von Feuerwehren einfordert.Kommentar: Susanne Daubel

programme.title: Orte der Kindheit
programme.desc: In this episode, Peter Schneeberger accompanies the singer and actress Marianne Mendt to the places of her childhood. Fruhest childhood was musically talented and improvised at the piano in the parental apartment in the third district. However, she visited the commuter school and learned a business school. / In dieser Folge begleitet Peter Schneeberger die Sangerin und Schauspielerin Marianne Mendt an die Orte ihrer Kindheit.Seit fruhester Kindheit war die geburtige Wienerin musikalisch auSSerst begabt und improvisierte am Klavier in der elterlichen Wohnung im dritten Bezirk.Als ihr der Vater eine Ella Fitzgerald-Platte schenkte, war fur sie der Entschluss klar: "Das will ich auch machen!" - und so kam es auch.Sie erhielt Klavier- und Gesangsunterricht, sang im Kinderchor des Konservatoriums der Stadt Wien und gewann bereits mit 12 Jahren ihren ersten Gesangswettbewerb.Auf Wunsch der Mutter besuchte sie jedoch die Handelsschule und erlernte einen kaufmannischen Beruf.Im Gesprach erzahlt die bemerkenswerte Kunstlerin, wie sie ihren Wunsch, auf der Buhne zu stehen, zielstrebig umsetzte.

programme.title: Kolumbien - die Schatten der Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Nach mehr als einem halben Jahrhundert Burgerkrieg in Kolumbien gelten noch immer uber hunderttausend Menschen als vermisst. Der Friedensprozess ist ins Stocken geraten, die jahrzehntelangen Kampfe zwischen linken Guerillas und rechten Paramilitars haben weite Teile des Landes gesetzlos gemacht, die beruchtigten Drogenkartelle haben die Gewalt weiter verschlimmert.Im WELTjournal reist Reporterin Natashya Gutierrez in ein Land, das bemuht ist, sich mit seiner Vergangenheit auseinanderzusetzen und die Traumata zu bewaltigen. Die kolumbianische Regierung hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Leichen der Vermissten zu finden und ihre Überreste an die Familien zu ubergeben. Sie hofft, die qualende Ungewissheit vieler Familien uber das Schicksal ihrer verschwundenen Angehorigen beenden zu konnen, denn nur so ist es den Hinterbliebenen moglich, endlich abzuschlieSSen .Gestaltung: Natashya Gutierrez

programme.title: Geiselhaft im Amazonas - Kolumbiens prominente Entfuhrte
programme.desc: Kolumbien kommt nicht zur Ruhe. Ungeachtet des Friedensprozesses, der den jahrzehntelangen Burgerkrieg beenden soll, kommt es wieder vermehrt zu Gewalt. Entfuhrungen nehmen wieder zu, sowohl politisch motivierte als auch Entfuhrungen um Losegeld.Das WELTjournal+ zeigt das Schicksal der wohl prominentesten Geisel Kolumbiens, Ingrid Betancourt: die damalige Prasidentschaftskandidatin war 2002 von der marxistischen Guerilla-Organisation FARC entfuhrt worden und kam erst nach sechseinhalb Jahre Gefangenschaft im Dschungel wieder frei. Betancourt und ihre ebenfalls entfuhrte Wahlkampfleiterin Clara Rojas berichten uber die Bedingungen ihrer Geiselhaft, bei der sie mit dutzenden anderen Entfuhrten hinter Stacheldraht eingesperrt waren. AuSSerdem kommen ehemalige FARC-Mitglieder, kolumbianische Politiker und Geheimdienstmitarbeiter zu Wort, die Insider-Informationen uber die groSSte Rebellengruppe des Landes preisgeben.Gestaltung: Julie Peyrard, Christophe Astruc

Die Pflanzen durfen sich ihre Platze hier selbst aussuchen. Ein Teich bietet Lebensraum fur viele Tiere und der Rasen ist zugunsten vieler Bluhpflanzen gewichen.Ein goldener Herbst unter dem Motto: grau raus - Farbe rein. Karl Ploberger stellt seine ganz personliche Hitparade der schonsten Herbstpflanzen vor.Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch zaubert ihre herbstlich-bunten "Esperanza-Rollen" auf Basis der Kapuzinerkresse.Auf der Garten Tulln braucht ein Sitzplatz unter der Pergola in der "Natur sucht Garten"-Anlage Beschattung. Die Gartnerinnen haben sich fur Kletterpflanzen entschieden.Karl Ploberger beantwortet die Gartenfrage der Woche: Wie setze ich Blumenzwiebeln richtig und wie tief kommen sie in die Erde?

programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Tirol
programme.sub-title: The little ones among the giants - the Tux Alps / Die Kleinen unter den Riesen - Die Tuxer Alpen
programme.desc: The Tux Alps, surrounded by the Zillertal Alps, Stubaier Alpen and the Karwendel, are less well known, but still impressive. The Wattener Lizum is located in the center: used by the Armed Forces, an Alpine Club Hutte and the Almwirtschaft. As early as 1610, the Haller doctor Hippolyt Guarinoni explored the region and initiated the construction of the Karlskirche in Volders and other chapels. In Hintertux there is an old thermal bath that is still in operation. It is interesting to see the story of a farmer from Navis who was seen 50 years ago in one of the first "Austria pictures". / Die Tuxer Alpen, umgeben von den Zillertaler Alpen, Stubaier Alpen und dem Karwendel, sind weniger bekannt, aber dennoch beeindruckend. Im Zentrum befindet sich die Wattener Lizum: genutzt vom Bundesheer, einer Alpenvereinshutte und der Almwirtschaft. Bereits 1610 erkundete der Haller Arzt Hippolyt Guarinoni die Region und initiierte den Bau der Karlskirche in Volders sowie weiterer Kapellen. In Hintertux gibt es ein altes Thermalbad, das noch in Betrieb ist. Interessant ist die Geschichte eines Bauern aus Navis, der vor 50 Jahren in einem der ersten "Österreich Bilder" zu sehen war.

programme.title: Kolumbien - die Schatten der Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Nach mehr als einem halben Jahrhundert Burgerkrieg in Kolumbien gelten noch immer uber hunderttausend Menschen als vermisst. Der Friedensprozess ist ins Stocken geraten, die jahrzehntelangen Kampfe zwischen linken Guerillas und rechten Paramilitars haben weite Teile des Landes gesetzlos gemacht, die beruchtigten Drogenkartelle haben die Gewalt weiter verschlimmert.Im WELTjournal reist Reporterin Natashya Gutierrez in ein Land, das bemuht ist, sich mit seiner Vergangenheit auseinanderzusetzen und die Traumata zu bewaltigen. Die kolumbianische Regierung hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Leichen der Vermissten zu finden und ihre Überreste an die Familien zu ubergeben. Sie hofft, die qualende Ungewissheit vieler Familien uber das Schicksal ihrer verschwundenen Angehorigen beenden zu konnen, denn nur so ist es den Hinterbliebenen moglich, endlich abzuschlieSSen .Gestaltung: Natashya Gutierrez

programme.title: Geiselhaft im Amazonas - Kolumbiens prominente Entfuhrte
programme.desc: Kolumbien kommt nicht zur Ruhe. Ungeachtet des Friedensprozesses, der den jahrzehntelangen Burgerkrieg beenden soll, kommt es wieder vermehrt zu Gewalt. Entfuhrungen nehmen wieder zu, sowohl politisch motivierte als auch Entfuhrungen um Losegeld.Das WELTjournal+ zeigt das Schicksal der wohl prominentesten Geisel Kolumbiens, Ingrid Betancourt: die damalige Prasidentschaftskandidatin war 2002 von der marxistischen Guerilla-Organisation FARC entfuhrt worden und kam erst nach sechseinhalb Jahre Gefangenschaft im Dschungel wieder frei. Betancourt und ihre ebenfalls entfuhrte Wahlkampfleiterin Clara Rojas berichten uber die Bedingungen ihrer Geiselhaft, bei der sie mit dutzenden anderen Entfuhrten hinter Stacheldraht eingesperrt waren. AuSSerdem kommen ehemalige FARC-Mitglieder, kolumbianische Politiker und Geheimdienstmitarbeiter zu Wort, die Insider-Informationen uber die groSSte Rebellengruppe des Landes preisgeben.Gestaltung: Julie Peyrard, Christophe Astruc

programme.title: Am Schauplatz
programme.desc: A reportage on conflicts on private basic studies between chicane and real possession. The trouble on lawyers' letters, which threaten to go over or shortly in a parking space with a lawsuit for possession of possessions, has become increasingly bigger in recent years. Anyone who does not pay threatens a negotiation in court. Lawyers, drivers clubs and now also politicians are trying to put a stop to this rip-off. But where are it about harassment - and where is real possession? Ulla Kramar-Schmid and Christoph Seibel are driven across Austria for the "at the scene" reportage "." As I get out. "As I get out, I see the small signs that you get a lawsuit when you stop. I look on the left, on the right, in any case I went back in and went away immediately - and I thought nothing about it, "said one person affected in Salzburg briefly in a poorly signposted parking lot next to a shopping center. Three weeks later, she received a payment request of 350 euros - with a threat of action, if she does not deposit. Casting in Dornbirn. And there are three small children, you always have to say that you are not surfing there because there are cars, "the farmer explains. / Eine Reportage uber Konflikte auf privaten Grundstucken zwischen Schikane und echter Besitzstorung.Der Ärger uber Anwalts-Schreiben, die wegen eines schnellen Umdrehens oder kurzen Haltens auf einem Parkplatz mit einer Klage wegen Besitzstorung drohen, ist in den letzten Jahren immer groSSer geworden. Wer nicht zahlt, dem droht eine Verhandlung vor Gericht. Anwalte, Autofahrer-Clubs und nun auch die Politik versuchen, dieser Abzocke einen Riegel vorzuschieben. Doch wo handelt es sich um Schikane - und wo um wirkliche Besitzstorung? Ulla Kramar-Schmid und Christoph Seibel sind fur die "Am Schauplatz"-Reportage "Geschaftsmodell Abzocke quer durch Österreich gefahren und haben Betroffene besucht."Wie ich aussteige, sehe ich die kleinen Schilder, dass du eine Besitzstorungsklage bekommst, wenn du stehen bleibst. Ich schau links, schau rechts, auf jeden Fall bin ich sofort wieder eingestiegen und weggefahren - und hab mir nichts dabei gedacht", erzahlt eine Betroffene, die in Salzburg kurz auf einem schlecht ausgeschilderten Parkplatz neben einem Einkaufscenter gehalten hat. Drei Wochen spater hat sie eine Zahlungsaufforderung von 350 Euro erhalten - mit einer Klagsandrohung, sollte sie nicht einzahlen.Doch es hat sich auch gezeigt: Nicht jede Drohung mit einer Besitzstorungsklage ist Schikane. In Dornbirn etwa wird ein Bauernhof an einer BundesstraSSe notorisch als Wendeplatz fur PKW und LKW missbraucht. "Man hat mir darum schon den Hund zusammengefahren, denn der Hund ist einem Auto nachgelaufen, weil das war sein Revier. Und es sind drei kleine Kinder da, immer musst du sagen, ihr durft da nicht vor gehen, weil da sind Autos.", erzahlt die Bauerin.

programme.title: Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Videospiele als Big Business - der harte Weg zum Erfolg in der milliardenschweren Spieleindustrie
programme.desc: Almost the half of the world bustle plays video games - and there are more and more. The gaming industry behind it has risen to the largest entertainment industry in the world and, with almost $ 200 billion, generates more than the music and film industry. But while the sales are booming and the number of players continues to rise, the mood within the industry is bad. Finally, reports have made headlines about massive waves. Tens of thousands have lost their jobs in the game industry in the past few months, many game projects have been stamped and entire developer studios were closed. Millions of productions were partly released and taken offline after just a few days due to unsuccessful. Many want to turn their hobby into a profession as a "game designer" - also in Austria. But if you dare to take the step and based your own developer studio, you have to compete with increasing worldwide competition. Because it has never been so easy to develop and make a video game. The progress of artificial intelligence already plays an important role. How hard is the way to success in the billion dollar gaming business? Can also be able to create the breakthrough from Austria? An Eco Special by Matthias Linke and Martin Steiner / Fast die Halfte der Weltbevolkerung spielt Videospiele - und es werden immer mehr. Die Gaming-Industrie dahinter ist zur groSSten Unterhaltungsbranche der Welt aufgestiegen und erwirtschaftet mit fast 200 Milliarden US-Dollar mehr als die Musik- und Filmindustrie gemeinsam. Doch wahrend die Umsatze boomen und die Spielerzahlen weiterhin steigen, ist die Stimmung innerhalb der Branche schlecht. Denn zuletzt haben Meldungen uber massive Kundigungswellen Schlagzeilen gemacht.Der Grund dafur: der Hype, der der Branche ab 2020 im Zuge der Corona-Pandemie massive Wachstumsraten bescherte, ist vorbei. Zehntausende haben ihre Jobs in der Spieleindustrie in den letzten Monaten verloren, viele Game-Projekte wurden eingestampft und ganze Entwicklerstudios geschlossen. Millionenschwere Produktionen wurden teils veroffentlicht und wegen Erfolglosigkeit schon nach wenigen Tagen wieder offline genommen.Trotzdem drangen aktuell immer mehr junge Menschen in die Branche. Viele wollen ihr Hobby als "Game-Designer" zum Beruf machen - auch in Österreich. Doch wer den Schritt wagt und ein eigenes Entwicklerstudio grundet, muss sich mit immer groSSer werdender weltweiter Konkurrenz messen. Denn noch nie war es so einfach, ein Videospiel zu entwickeln und zu veroffentlichen. Eine wesentliche Rolle spielt dabei bereits jetzt der Fortschritt kunstlicher Intelligenz.Doch wie hart ist der Weg zum Erfolg im milliardenschweren Gaming-Business tatsachlich? Kann es auch gelingen von Österreich aus den Durchbruch zu schaffen?Ein Eco Spezial von Matthias Linke und Martin Steiner

programme.desc: For the prospective star lawyer Max, a world collapses when the Prater host Gabi imagines as his biological mother at his engagement festival.
