Dabei erkennt Vivien, dass die Madchen in Wahrheit verkauft werden.Vivien und Sophia planen daraufhin eine gemeinsame Flucht, wobei sie das grausame Geheimnis luften, was ihnen und ihren Mitschulerinnen im Falle eines Verkaufs bluht.Das kanadische Science-Fiction-Mysterydrama "Level 16" der Regisseurin Danishka Esterhazy ist als spezifisch weiblicher Genre-Film konzipiert und ahnelt in seinem Setting unter anderem der Erfolgsserie und Buchverfilmung "The Handmaids Tale".Trotz des dystopischen Charakters sowie eines gewissen Horroreinschlags setzt sich Esterhazy in ihrem Film auch mit der Gefuhlswelt ihrer eigenen Schulzeit auseinander.

programme.title: In foreign hands E26 (e) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε26 (Ε)

Όσο ο φίλος του τελεί υπό κράτηση, ο Ταρζάν βρίσκει καταφύγιο στο σπίτι του Πιπερόπουλου. Μπροστά στις εξελίξεις, η Σούλα, ο Λουδοβίκος και η Μάρω σπεύδουν να συμπαρασταθούν στην Τόνια.

programme.title: In foreign hands E27 (e) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε27 (Ε)
programme.desc: Manos is called upon to make the final decision on whether he will eventually marry Maritina. Tonia begs Florian to tell her where the child has and he denies any involvement. Η Τόνια παρακαλάει τον Φλοριάν να της πει πού έχει το παιδί κι εκείνος αρνείται κάθε ανάμειξη. Η Πελαγία αποφασίζει να αλλάξει μαμά.

programme.title: The Law of Teerao / A Lei de Teerao
programme.desc: Samad, police officer at the Narcotic Brigade in Teerao, looks for a dangerous local drug cheap, Nasser Khakzad. After many attempts, you can find it by finding it after a failed suicide attempt. While Nasser goes through the legal procedures that will lead him to the death penalty and execution, Samad begins to realize that it was the social conditions and the completely corrupt institutions of society that forced Nasser to the criminal life it led. The arrests and executions he made in his career then begin to present themselves as useless and without any impact on the drug problem in the Irao. What seemed to be a victory becomes the beginning of an unexpected and dangerous confrontation that will change their lives forever. Making a portrait of a question rarely addressed in Iranian cinema, Saeed Rousa dives into the obscure world of drug trafficking and calls attention to the exponential increase in the number of toxicode dependents, many of which shelter, for the ease of drug access and the disability of police forces in combating this epidemic. / Samad, agente de polícia na brigada de narcoticos em Teerao, procura um perigoso barao de droga local, Nasser Khakzad. Depois de muitas tentativas, consegue localizá-lo, encontrando-o apos uma tentativa de suicídio falhada. Enquanto Nasser passa pelos procedimentos legais que o levarao à pena de morte e à execuçao, Samad começa a perceber que foram as condições sociais e as instituições completamente corruptas da sociedade que forçaram Nasser à vida criminosa que levou. As detenções e execuções que fez na sua carreira começam entao a apresentar-se como algo inútil e sem qualquer impacto no problema de droga no Irao. O que parecia ser uma vitoria torna-se o início de um confronto inesperado e perigoso que mudará as suas vidas para sempre. Fazendo um retrato de uma questao poucas vezes abordada no cinema iraniano, Saeed Roustaee mergulha no mundo obscuro do narcotráfico e chama a atençao para o aumento exponencial do número de toxicodependentes, muitos dos quais sem abrigo, para a facilidade do acesso à droga e para a incapacidade das forças policiais no combate a esta epidemia.

programme.desc: It's 10 pm and Bairro Alto is transformed into a fair. The bars compete with each other to see who sells more alcohol, challenging the boundaries of those who pass. Instead of glasses, the drinks are served in buckets. Farewells of singles, finalist trips. programme.title: Manchester United vs Chelsea - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 5
programme.desc: Manchester United are unbeaten in their last 12 Premier League home games against Chelsea since a 0-1 defeat in May 2013. Indeed, Chelsea’s win rate of 18% at Old Trafford in the Premier League is their lowest away to any side they have visited 10+ times in the competition. The Blues’ two wins in their last three league games versus the Red Devils are as many as their previous 17 beforehand.

programme.title: Burnley vs Nottingham Forest - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 5
programme.desc: Both sides have scored in six of the last seven league meetings between Burnley and Nottingham Forest, with the only exception a 1-0 win for the Clarets in the Championship in February 2016. After their 2-1 win at Turf Moor on the final day of the 2023-24 season, Nottingham Forest could win back-to-back league meetings against Burnley for the first time since September 2003, and first time in the top-flight since March 1967. programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Sawm
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan.

programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Hockey - KHL: tractor - Avangard / Hokej - KHL: Traktor - Avangard
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other Hockey League of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL Plejofa received a prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed the Russian team wins the title of Russia Champions. Since 2011. The League except the clubs from the former USSR includes clubs from Central Europe, while since 2016. One Chinese representative enters first. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. programme.desc: The champions handball league has since 1955. year when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Utrecht - Lyon
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Multiprenos / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Multiprenos
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Multiprenos / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Multiprenos
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Buducnost - Partizan / Košarka - ABA liga: Buducnost - Partizan
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Exatlon Germany: Mega Challenge: Battle of City / EXATLON Nemčija: Mega izziv: Bitka mest
My style is the best / Moj stil je najboljši
Kontejnerske vojne: Zimske igre
programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. In this game of high inserts, to overcome opponents who also want to enrich, it also requires a good nose for mild and steel nerves. Because these are large sums of money, this is not a game, but a real war. Meet John Kunkl's auctions and auction participants who are fighting for the best bargains, including Jason R. Hughes and Matthew Gaus. Who will be out of the "container wars" as a winner? / Povsem nova serija "Kontejnerske vojne" dokazuje, da dobro stanje na bančnem računu še ne zagotavlja uspeha v svetu pristaniških dražb, v katerem se vse dogaja z bliskovitim tempom. V tej igri visokih vložkov sta za premagovanje nasprotnikov, ki si prav tako želijo obogateti, potrebna tudi dober nos za blago in jekleni živci. Ker gre za velike vsote denarja, to ni nikakršna igra, pač pa prava vojna. Spoznajte dražbarja Johna Kunkla in udeležence dražb, ki se med seboj borijo za najboljše kupčije, med katerimi sta tudi Jason R. Hughes in Matthew Gaus. Kdo bo iz "Kontejnerskih vojn" izšel kot zmagovalec?

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - NK Bravo, Prvaliga 2025/2026, First League / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - NK Bravo, PrvaLiga 2025/2026, Prva Liga
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (m): din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, European League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, Evropska liga 2025/26
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFA since 1971. The non -deputy predecessor of this competition has been the Cup of the Vele Tezje cities, which took place between 1955 and 1971. Since then, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that purpose. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season, groups of eliminations have been introduced. The Cup was designed in 1972 by Italian artist Bertoni for the UEFE Cup Finals and is awarded every year to the winner, with a year left. / Drugo najprestižnejše klubsko nogometno tekmovanje v Evropi je uradno pod okriljem Evropske nogometne zveze Uefe od leta 1971. Neslužbeni predhodnik tega tekmovanja je bil Pokal velesejemskih mest, kateri se je odvijal med letoma 1955 in 1971. Od takrat naprej se tekmovanje uradno imenuje Pokal Uefe in pod tem namenom se odvija vse do leta 2009, ko je bil preimenovan v Evropsko ligo. Skozi leta se je sam format tekmovanja nekajkrat spremenil, od sezone 2004/2005 pa je uvedeno tekmovanje po skupinah, kateremu sledijo eliminacije. Pokal je leta 1972 dizajniral italijanski umetnik Bertoni za finale Pokala Uefe in vsako leto ga dodelijo zmagovalcu, pri katerem ostane leto dni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - NK Bravo, Prvaliga 2025/2026, First League / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - NK Bravo, PrvaLiga 2025/2026, Prva Liga
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (m): din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, European League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, Evropska liga 2025/26
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFA since 1971. The non -deputy predecessor of this competition has been the Cup of the Vele Tezje cities, which took place between 1955 and 1971. Since then, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that purpose. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season, groups of eliminations have been introduced. The Cup was designed in 1972 by Italian artist Bertoni for the UEFE Cup Finals and is awarded every year to the winner, with a year left. / Drugo najprestižnejše klubsko nogometno tekmovanje v Evropi je uradno pod okriljem Evropske nogometne zveze Uefe od leta 1971. Neslužbeni predhodnik tega tekmovanja je bil Pokal velesejemskih mest, kateri se je odvijal med letoma 1955 in 1971. Od takrat naprej se tekmovanje uradno imenuje Pokal Uefe in pod tem namenom se odvija vse do leta 2009, ko je bil preimenovan v Evropsko ligo. Skozi leta se je sam format tekmovanja nekajkrat spremenil, od sezone 2004/2005 pa je uvedeno tekmovanje po skupinah, kateremu sledijo eliminacije. Pokal je leta 1972 dizajniral italijanski umetnik Bertoni za finale Pokala Uefe in vsako leto ga dodelijo zmagovalcu, pri katerem ostane leto dni.

programme.title: Football (m): din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, European League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, Evropska liga 2025/26
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFA since 1971. The non -deputy predecessor of this competition has been the Cup of the Vele Tezje cities, which took place between 1955 and 1971. Since then, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that purpose. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season, groups of eliminations have been introduced. The Cup was designed in 1972 by Italian artist Bertoni for the UEFE Cup Finals and is awarded every year to the winner, with a year left. / Drugo najprestižnejše klubsko nogometno tekmovanje v Evropi je uradno pod okriljem Evropske nogometne zveze Uefe od leta 1971. Neslužbeni predhodnik tega tekmovanja je bil Pokal velesejemskih mest, kateri se je odvijal med letoma 1955 in 1971. Od takrat naprej se tekmovanje uradno imenuje Pokal Uefe in pod tem namenom se odvija vse do leta 2009, ko je bil preimenovan v Evropsko ligo. Skozi leta se je sam format tekmovanja nekajkrat spremenil, od sezone 2004/2005 pa je uvedeno tekmovanje po skupinah, kateremu sledijo eliminacije. Pokal je leta 1972 dizajniral italijanski umetnik Bertoni za finale Pokala Uefe in vsako leto ga dodelijo zmagovalcu, pri katerem ostane leto dni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - NK Bravo, Prvaliga 2025/2026, First League / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - NK Bravo, PrvaLiga 2025/2026, Prva Liga
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football: UEFA European League: highlights / Nogomet: UEFA Evropska liga: vrhunci
programme.desc: The European League is a competition of European football clubs, organized by Uefa since 1971, until 2009 under the name of the Uefa Cup. It is the second most powerful competition of European football, just behind the Champions League and is the successor to the Cup of the Vele Cities, which took place between 1955 and 1971. Check out the most interesting moments of this competition. / Evropska liga je tekmovanje evropskih nogometnih klubov, ki ga od leta 1971 organizira UEFA, do leta 2009 pod imenom Pokal UEFA. Je drugo najmočnejše tekmovanje evropskega nogometa, takoj za Ligo prvakov in je naslednik Pokala velesejemskih mest, ki se je odvijal med letoma 1955 in 1971. Oglejte si najzanimivejše trenutke tega tekmovanja.

Citronka as a tree of South American cabbage, which was brought to Europe in the 17th century by Spaniards, excited about its citron scent, is called citron. programme.title: Odsevanja, dokumentarni portret Vinka Moderndorferja, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Meško Primož ... Vinko Moderndorfer, writer, poet, playwright, essayist, theater, radio, film and television director is one of the most fruitful, recognized and awarded creators of recent period. / R: Meško Primož... Vinko Moderndorfer, pisatelj, pesnik, dramatik, esejist, gledališki, radijski, filmski in televizijski režiser sodi med najbolj plodovite, priznane in večkrat nagrajene ustvarjalce zadnjega obdobja.
programme.desc: The film portrait emphasizes the various fields of his creation: directing the performances of Evgeny Onegin in SNG Opera and Ballet Ljubljana, working in a radio studio, talks on the premises of Viba Film and presenting the Moderndorfer Theater. His theater, film and literary poetics are revealed in dialogues with colleagues and companions. In doing so, they touch on the basic provisions of his creation - social sensitivity, social criticality, love, eroticism and humor. When visiting the Mountain Cave, the viewer enters the most intimate world through the game of reflections, awakening the memories of the childhood and visiting the homestead of his grandfather, teacher, ethnologist and socialist in Dol, Carinthia. The story of an artist who creates with inexorable sincerity, dedication and a demand for human dignity. Screenplay Cvetka Bevc, directed by Primož Meško, director of photography and cameraman Andrej Lupinc. / Filmski portret poudari različna področja njegovega ustvarjanja: režijo predstave Evgenij Onjegin v SNG Opera in balet Ljubljana, delo v radijskem studiu, pogovore v prostorih Viba filma in predstavitev monografije Gledališče Moderndorfer. Njegova gledališka, filmska in literarna poetika se razkriva v dialogih s sodelavci in sopotniki. Pri tem se dotikajo osnovnih določil njegovega ustvarjanja – socialne občutljivosti, družbene kritičnosti, ljubezni, erotike in humorja. The history of the deaf education proves that it was not always easy for them. In the second half of the 19th century, the use of sign language in schools was prohibited, and children had to learn by oral or speech method. programme.title: Bite Science: Radioactive followers, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Radioaktivna sledila, pon.
programme.desc: The Hungarian chemist and Nobel laureate Georg von Hevesy, as a young student, suspected that his housewife was preparing dishes from several days old remains. In order to prove this, he sprinkled food with a radioactive trace, and when he served the same food, he checked with a detector that he was radioactive. His suspicions were confirmed. This was the first use of radioactive followed. Today, this method is something quite common. We can follow molecules in plants, in our body, monitoring the movement of fish flocks, sea currents. Radioactive followed us reveal ways that we would not otherwise see. They can also protect endangered animals and valuables. / Madžarski kemik in Nobelov nagrajenec Georg von Hevesy je kot mlad študent sumil, da mu njegova gospodinja pripravlja jedi iz več dni starih ostankov. Da bi to dokazal, je hrano posipal z radioaktivnim sledilom, in ko mu je postregla isto hrano, z detektorjem preveril, ali je radioaktivna. Njegovi sumi so bili potrjeni. To je bila prva uporaba radioaktivnih sledil. Danes je ta metoda nekaj povsem običajnega. Sledimo lahko molekulam v rastlinah, v našem telesu, spremljamo gibanje ribjih jat, morskih tokov. Radioaktivna sledila nam razkrivajo poti, ki jih sicer ne bi videli. Z njimi pa lahko tudi varujemo ogrožene živali in dragocenosti.

programme.desc: The film tells the story of Gertrude Bell, who, as a historian, writer and member of the British secret intelligence service in the 1920s, played a key role in the formation of a new political order in the Middle East. Following a tragic relationship with a diplomat and an unwavering gambler Henry Cadogan, she decides to put her private life on the sidelines and discover the country as a researcher. While the Ottoman Empire is slowly falling apart, Gertrude Bell learns languages, translates literature, learns Muslim dignitaries in Cairo, Basra and Baghdad, and gains their confidence with his courage and respect. As a mediator between the Orient and the British Empire after the First World War, she contributes to the determination of new borders in the country. Original title: Queen of the Desertleto Production: 2015 Spring: USA, Morocagulus: Biographical Film Studies: Werner Herzogscenario: Werner Herzogigrada: Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis. / Film pripoveduje zgodbo o Gertrude Bell, ki je kot zgodovinarka, pisateljica in članica Britanske tajne obveščevalne službe v 20. letih prejšnjega stoletja odigrala ključno vlogo pri oblikovanju novega političnega reda na Bližnjem vzhodu. Po tragičnem razmerju z diplomatom in nepoboljšljivim kockarjem Henryjem Cadoganom se odloči, da postavi zasebno življenje na stranski tir in deželo odkrije kot raziskovalka. Medtem ko Otomansko cesarstvo počasi razpada, se Gertrude Bell uči jezikov, prevaja literaturo, spoznava muslimanske dostojanstvenike v Kairu, Basri in Bagdadu ter s svojim pogumom in spoštljivostjo pridobi njihovo zaupanje. Kot mediatorka med Orientom in Britanskim imperijem po prvi svetovni vojni prispeva k določanju novih meja v deželi. programme.sub-title: Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, only the premier fascist; He embodied the Alliance between fascist Italy and Nazi Germany and reigned to the people as a new Caesar and the heir of the imperial rhyme. Documentary series in two parts presents the story of a duče / Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, Le Premier Fasciste; Utelesil je zavezništvo med fašistično Italijo in nacistično Nemčijo ter zavladal ljudstvu kot novi cezar in dedič cesarskega Rima. Dokumentarna serija v dveh delih predstavi zgodbo o duče
programme.desc: Part 1: Benito Mussolini was born in a poor village near Venice. As a young man, he repeatedly landed behind the latch due to the revolutionary incitement. He then transformed into a nationalist. Determined to turn Italy into a world superpower modeled after the Roman Empire, Mussolini took power in 1922 after a march to Rome and introduced fascism into the country. He ruled with a hard hand, but the Italians, as well as the Italian Jews, admired him, promising them the rebirth of the country. His regime was also inspired by Adolf Hitler, who became a Firer of Germany in 1933. Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, only the Prime Minister of the Fascist / France / 2021 / Director: Serge de Sampignny. / 1. del:Benito Mussolini se je rodil v revni vasici blizu Benetk. Kot mladenič je zaradi revolucionarnega hujskaštva večkrat pristal za zapahi. Nato se je prelevil v nacionalista. Odločen, da Italijo spremeni v svetovno velesilo po vzoru rimskega cesarstva, je Mussolini leta 1922 po pohodu na Rim prevzel oblast in v državo vpeljal fašizem. Vladal je s trdo roko, toda Italijani, pa tudi italijanski Judje, so ga občudovali, saj jim je obljubljal preporod države. Njegov režim pa je navdihnil tudi Adolfa Hitlerja, ki je leta 1933 postal firer Nemčije. MUSSOLINI, THE FASCIST EMPEROR / MUSSOLINI, LE PREMIER FASCISTE / Francija / 2021 / Režija: Serge de Sampigny.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: Lenart Krečič and Big Band RTV Slovenia, guests Gene Lake and Boris Kozlov, Max Club Jazz Festival Velenje, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Lenart Krečič in Big Band RTV Slovenija, gosta Gene Lake in Boris Kozlov, Max Klub Jazz Festival Velenje, pon.

At the opening concert of the Jazz Max Club Festival in Velenje, young Slovenian jazz creator Lenart Krečič presented himself with an author's program in the company Big Banda RTV Slovenia and two music guests. At a highly respected university, he completed his master's degree in improvisation, he had the opportunity to get to know and create with many giants of jazz music and perform in numerous renowned jazz clubs, including Blue Note, Iridium and Jazz Gallery. He brought two excellent guest musicians, American drummer Gen Lak and bassist Boris Kozlov, who is native to Russian, and live and work in New York to New York. The program, prepared and led by Lenart Krečič, was featured with seven author's songs written right for the occasion and performers. / R: Švigelj Tomaž... Na otvoritvenem koncertu Jazz festivala Max kluba v Velenju se je z avtorskim programom v družbi Big Banda RTV Slovenija in dveh glasbenih gostov predstavil mladi slovenski džezovski ustvarjalec Lenart Krečič. Saksofonist, aranžer in skladatelj, razpet med ZDA in Slovenijo, je v New Yorku, metropoli džezovske glasbe, živel in deloval kar sedem let. Na zelo cenjeni univerzi je končal magistrski študij iz improvizacije, imel je priložnost spoznati in ustvarjati s številnimi velikani džezovske glasbe in nastopiti v številnih priznanih džezovskih klubih, med drugimi v Blue note, Iridium in Jazz Gallery. Na tokratni koncert v Slovenijo je pripeljal dva izvrstna gostujoča glasbenika, ameriškega bobnarja Gena Laka in basista Borisa Kozlova, ki je po rodu Rus, živi in deluje pa v New Yorku. programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. We know them. A series that punctures the RSI schedule makes us know the great treasures of the planet that hosts us. The national sanctuary of Djoudj's birds (French: Parc National des Oiseaux du Djoudj) is located on the south-eastern bank of the Senegal river, in thelomonymous state, north-east of Saint-Louis. It includes habitats of various types, aquatic and terrestrial, which host numerous species of migratory birds, many of which have crossed the Sahara desert to reach it. Of the approximately 400 species of birds, the most numerous are pelicans and flamingos. The colonies of Pagliaroli from Europe are less important; For this type of bird, the park is Lunic known winter place. There are numerous other inhabitants of the park, which has been inserted among the heritage assets of the Unnesco. Source wikipedia / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita. Il Santuario nazionale degli uccelli di Djoudj (francese: Parc national des oiseaux du Djoudj) si trova sulla riva sud-orientale del fiume Senegal, nellomonimo stato, a nord-est di Saint-Louis. Comprende habitat di vario tipo, acquatici e terrestri, che ospitano numerose specie di uccelli migratori, molti dei quali hanno attraversato il deserto del Sahara per raggiungerlo. Delle circa 400 specie di uccelli i più numerosi sono i pellicani ed i fenicotteri. Meno importanti le colonie di pagliaroli provenienti dallEuropa; per questo tipo di uccelli il parco è lunico luogo invernale conosciuto. Esistono numerosi altri abitanti del parco, il quale è stato inserito tra i Patrimoni dellumanità dellUNESCO. Fonte Wikipedia

programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. programme.title: Mountain Life - dream house wanted / Mountain Life - Traumhaus gesucht
programme.desc: From the forested mountain tops of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the east of Appalachen about soon Mountain with its grandiose alpine sports, the Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah and the picturesque peaks of the rockies to Hawaiis Tropical Mauna Loa: There are numerous remote mountains in the United States. They are the perfect jerking point for stressed city and swinged families who escape from traffic chaos, hustle and bustle and pollution. And as different as the mountain destinations are, the real estate are so different, because, dependent on budgets and giftability, there are almost everything-from the rustic log hat with wood stove to the bamboo-bungalow with a volcanic view to a full-glazed design object with a private spa. The documentary series accompanies mountain fans in their search for the dream house. / Von den bewaldeten Bergkuppen der Blue Ridge Mountains im Osten der Appalachen uber Bald Mountain mit seinen grandiosen Alpinsportmoglichkeiten, das Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah und die malerischen Gipfel der Rockies bis zu Hawaiis tropischem Mauna Loa: In den Vereinigten Staaten gibt es zahlreiche abgelegene Gebirgsorte, die kaum jemand kennt. Sie sind der perfekte Ruckzugsort fur gestresste Stadter und erschopfte Familien, die vor Verkehrschaos, Hektik und Umweltverschmutzung fluchten. Und so unterschiedlich die Mountain-Destinationen sind, so verschieden sind auch die Immobilien, denn, abhangig von Budgets und Verfugbarkeit gibt es fast alles – von der rustikalen Blockhutte mit Holzofen uber den Bambus-Bungalow mit Vulkanblick bis hin zum vollverglasten Designobjekt mit privatem Spa. Die Doku-Serie begleitet Berg-Fans bei ihrer Suche nach dem Traumhaus.

programme.title: Living (t) room / Wohn(t)raum

programme.title: Mountain men - survival in the wilderness / Mountain Men - Überleben in der Wildnis
programme.desc: Three men have decided to devote their life to simple survival. And not as simple as it sounds at first. Without any connection to modern life, they spend their time in the rough mountains of America, cattle with hungry animals, mudslide, storms and falling trees to obtain what they need to live. / Drei Manner haben sich entschieden, ihr Leben dem simplen Überleben zu widmen. Ohne jedwede Verbindung zum modernen Leben verbringen sie ihre Zeit in der rauen Bergwelt Amerikas, kampfen mit hungrigen Tieren, Schlammlawinen, Unwetter und fallenden Baumen um sich selber zu beschaffen, was sie zum Leben brauchen.

programme.title: Fruhling
programme.sub-title: Love me when you can / Lieb mich, wenn du kannst
programme.desc: Village helper Katja Baumann (Simone Thomalla) sets off with her friends Philippa (Cristina do Rego) and Michelle Schmid (Johanna Klante) to make a kite flight over the mountains. But unfortunately the fun is prevented by a lovely eagle. On your jerk path you can see a school of Michelle who actually made school due to illness. Michelle is concerned about the boy named Freddie Loffler (Jascha Baum) because he already had drug problems. Freddie has so much potential. Michelle wants to speak to his parents. The Lofflers have a holiday farm with ponies and therefore always a lot to do. Freddie's father (Helmfried von Luttichau) does not understand the excitement and thinks anyway that the boy does not need a high school diploma. / Dorfhelferin Katja Baumann (Simone Thomalla) macht sich mit ihren Freundinnen Philippa (Cristina do Rego) und Michelle Schmid (Johanna Klante) auf, um einen Drachenflug uber die Berge zu machen. Aber leider wird der Spass durch einen liebeskranken Adler verhindert.Auf ihrem Ruckweg sehen sie einen Schuler von Michelle, der eigentlich wegen Krankheit die Schule ausfallen liess. Michelle sorgt sich um den Jungen namens Freddie Loffler (Jascha Baum), da er schon Drogenprobleme hatte. Dabei hat Freddie so viel Potential. Michelle will mit dessen Eltern sprechen. Die Lofflers haben einen Ferienhof mit Ponys und deshalb immer viel zu tun. Freddies Vater (Helmfried von Luttichau) versteht die Aufregung nicht und findet sowieso, dass der Junge kein Abitur braucht.

programme.title: Cold Blood - DNA of crime / Cold Blood - DNA des Verbrechens
programme.sub-title: A mother doesn't give up / Eine Mutter gibt nicht auf
programme.desc: Gloria Pointer is a cheerful teenager and enthusiastic cheerleader. When she does not appear for an event of her favorite sport, her mother immediately alerts the police. For a short time later, the officials find the lifeless body of the 14-year. It should take another 30 years before the cruel murder finally experiences its fair punishment. / Gloria Pointer ist ein lebensfroher Teenager und begeisterte Cheerleaderin. Als sie zu einer Veranstaltung ihres Lieblingssports nicht erscheint, alarmiert ihre Mutter sofort die Polizei. Kurze Zeit spater finden die Beamten den leblosen Korper der 14-Jahrigen. Es soll weitere 30 Jahre dauern, bis der grausame Morder endlich seine gerechte Strafe erfahrt.

programme.title: Club
programme.desc: What do spital, doctors, health insurance companies, cantons and patients contribute to? And which health system do we want to discuss as a society? With Peter Duggeli: - Kristian Schneider, Hospital Director/CEO of the hospital center Biel and Vice Prasident of H+; - Pierre Alain Schnegg, government councilor BE/SVP and health director Be; - Saskia Schenker, director of the health insurance association Prioswiss; - Tobias Burkhardt, family doctor and Prasident Medical Association Canton of Zurich; And - Simon Zurich, Board of Trustees Patient Organization Spo. / Was konnen Spitaler, Ärztinnen, Krankenkassen, Kantone und Patienten dazu beitragen? Und welches Gesundheitssystem wollen wir uns als Gesellschaft leisten?Mit Peter Duggeli diskutieren: – Kristian Schneider, Spitaldirektor/CEO des Spitalzentrums Biel und Vizeprasident von H+;– Pierre Alain Schnegg, Regierungsrat BE/SVP und Gesundheitsdirektor BE;– Saskia Schenker, Direktorin Krankenkassenverband Prioswiss;– Tobias Burkhardt, Hausarzt und Prasident Ärztegesellschaft Kanton Zurich; und – Simon Zurich, Stiftungsrat Patientenorganisation SPO.

programme.title: Mini Chuchi, Dini Chuchi / Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: On day 2 of “Mini Chuchi, Dini Chuchi”, military dares to go to the "Salmon". The 30-year-old lives in Buserach and has a large heart for animals. programme.title: Ding Dong
programme.desc: Viola Tami and Jan Fitze immerse themselves in the magical worlds of Occultist Akron and Magician Peter Marvey - two extraordinary artists, whose house is not the common place of residence, but are fascinating worlds of experience full of illusions, secrets and magic. / Viola Tami und Jan Fitze tauchen ein in die magischen Welten von Okkultist Akron und Magier Peter Marvey – zwei aussergewohnliche Kunstler, deren Hauser keine gewohnlichen Wohnorte, sondern faszinierende Erlebniswelten voller Illusionen, Geheimnisse und Zauber sind.

programme.title: Zu Tisch
programme.desc: A cake without sugar - no problem! Janna and Vangeli's Karama Figen are growing on the Greek island of Euboa. From this they also produce PEIMEZEI, fig syrup - as a sugar substitute. In the late summer is harvest time. From the fruits of your tree you prepare traditional and new dishes: pig with figs, figs in the bacon coat, cake or chutney. / Ein Kuchen ohne Zucker – kein Problem! Auf der griechischen Insel Euboa bauen Janna und Vangelis Karama Feigen an. Daraus stellen sie auch Petimezi her, Feigensirup – als Zuckerersatz. Im Spatsommer ist Erntezeit. Aus den Fruchten ihrer Baume bereiten sie traditionelle und neue Gerichte zu: Schwein mit Feigen, Feigen im Speckmantel, Kuchen oder auch Chutney.

programme.title: 1 against 100 / 1 gegen 100

programme.title: Sternstunde Philosophie

programme.desc: In his novels, Joachim Meyerhoff is so ancestry from the pitfalls of his life that every band becomes a bestseller. On the grave he slips into new roles just as credibly. But who is the real Meyerhoff, what is his true story? Or is it never real at all? / Joachim Meyerhoff erzahlt in seinen Romanen so anruhrend von den Fallstricken seines Lebens, dass jeder Band ein Bestseller wird. Auf der Buhne schlupft er ebenso glaubhaft in immer neue Rollen. Doch wer ist der wahre Meyerhoff, was ist seine wahre Geschichte? Oder gibt es ihn gar nie in echt?

programme.desc: Two years ago, his left toe stuck in the spines of the most poisonous fish in Europe, in Petermann. Today Philipp Kunz from Munchenstein BL was spared on this species and serves it to his four colleagues - to the main course of notaing. You can of course get the Petermannchen served without the poisonous backstreams, so garnished with memories of the painful bathing holidays in France. Philipp Kunz is the ambitious in the team. With the intent "The winner I am", the 46-year Basel bidder stands to the stove-well prepared with all its notes and drawings. Is it really noted on that? An ambitious hobby chef is portrayed: a “Basler Bebbi”, as it is in the textbook, Fasnachtler and FCB fan. All peace, joy, pancakes, you could think. If there was no diagnosis of multiple sclerosis that Philipp Kunz received six years ago. However, he cannot get it down by the disease. / Vor zwolf Jahren steckte seine linke Zehe in den Stacheln des giftigsten Fisches Europas, im Petermannchen. Heute nun ubt Philipp Kunz aus Munchenstein BL verspatete Rache an dieser Spezies und serviert sie seinen vier Mitstreitern – zum Hauptgang notabene. Aufgetischt bekommen sie die Petermannchen naturlich ohne die giftigen Ruckenstacheln, dafur garniert mit Erinnerungen an die schmerzhaften Badeferien in Frankreich.Philipp Kunz ist der Ehrgeizige im Team. Nur eine Kaseplatte oder ein Stuck Fleisch, das der Gast als Zumutung noch selber braten muss, kommen bei ihm nicht auf den Tisch. Self-made ist seine Devise, und da lasst sich der Projektleiter eines Telekommunikationsunternehmens so einiges einfallen: Sei es die leichte Curry-Zitronengras-Suppe neben dem Tatar aus Bundnerfleisch, das Cicorino-rosso-Risotto, das Rosmarin-Parfait oder die hausgemachten Florentiner. Mit dem Vorsatz «Der Gewinner bin ich» stellt sich der 46-jahrige Baselbieter an den Herd – gut vorbereitet mit all seinen Notizen und Zeichnungen. Ist darauf aber auch wirklich alles notiert?Die vierte Folge von «SRF bi de Lut - Mannerkuche» wird es zeigen. Portratiert wird ein ambitionierter Hobbykoch: ein «Basler Bebbi», wie er im Lehrbuch steht, Fasnachtler und FCB-Fan. Alles Friede, Freude, Eierkuchen, konnte man meinen. Wenn da nicht die Diagnose Multiple Sklerose ware, die Philipp Kunz vor sechs Jahren erhielt. Unterkriegen jedoch lasst er sich durch die Krankheit nicht.

programme.title: Rocky Mountains - where the West is still wild / Rocky Mountains – Wo der Westen noch wild ist
programme.desc: The Rocky Mountains are an important part of the US basic myth. It was the pioneers and settlers from Europe who, to start a new life and to conquer new land in the west, defeat the monumental Rocky Mountains. With up to 4400 meters high mountains, the mountain massif was long a obstacle to the west, to the Pacific, the “Final Frontier”. At the same time, the indigenous people had lived there in harmony with their country and nature for thousands of years. The mentality of the people who live in or on the mountains is still characterized by the thought of overcoming adversities and being overlooked in wild nature. / Die Rocky Mountains sind wichtiger Teil des US-amerikanischen Grundungsmythos. Es waren die Pioniere und Siedler aus Europa, die, um ein neues Leben zu beginnen und neues Land im Westen zu erobern, die monumentalen Rocky Mountains bezwangen.Mit bis zu 4400 Meter hohen Bergen war das Gebirgsmassiv lange ein schwer zu uberwindendes Hindernis auf dem Weg Richtung Westen, zum Pazifik, der «Final Frontier». Gleichzeitig hatten die Ureinwohner seit tausenden von Jahren dort in Harmonie mit ihrem Land und der Natur gelebt.Claudia Bates, USA-Korrespondentin des ZDF, und ihr Team stellen die Rocky Mountains vor. Noch immer ist die Mentalitat der Menschen, die im oder am Gebirge leben, gepragt vom Gedanken, Widrigkeiten zu uberwinden und in der wilden Natur zu uberleben.
